caption: The drawing features a single, large, outlined object centered within a rectangular border. The object is a teapot or coffee pot, defined by thin, precise black lines against a plain, light beige or off-white background. The pot has a wide, curved body with a distinct separation between the upper and lower halves, a prominent spout on the upper right side, and a large, angular handle on the upper left. The lid is domed with a knob at the top, and the base of the pot flares outward before tapering back in. There is no shading or color variation present; the composition consists entirely of clean, continuous contour lines. In the bottom right corner, there is a signature or inscription, also in thin black line.
title: Covered Water Pitcher
